summary: A stylised two-seat swan pedal boat for a park lake: a plump lofted fibreglass body hollowed into a cockpit w… joints pedal_crank, tiller, paddle_wheel, rudder; options plumage, beak; sockets seat_driver, seat_pax_1, eye_point, waterline, socket_bow.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.swan_paddle_boat or place "prefab": "swan_paddle_boat" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
